deals.excerpt_zh: Xbox 免费试玩活动回归，本周末可免费体验多款精选游戏。以下是完整免费游戏列表，试玩后购买还可享专属折扣。

deals.title: What the Previews Are Saying About Gears of War: E-Day
deals.excerpt: Hands-on previews for Gears of War: E-Day are live, and early reactions to the new Horde mode and campaign are overwhelmingly positive.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》试玩前瞻汇总：新 Horde 模式与战役反响热烈。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》试玩体验陆续公开，玩家对全新 Horde 模式与单人战役反响热烈。

deals.title: Gears of War: E-Day's New Horde Mode Raises Big Questions
deals.excerpt: While the new Horde mode in Gears of War: E-Day is the most interesting yet, it also leaves several gameplay questions unanswered.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 模式虽有趣，却留下了不少待解的玩法疑问。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 模式被评最有创意，但也留下了不少待解答的玩法疑问。

deals.title: Gears of War: E-Day Horde Siege Mode Is Addictive, Previews Say
deals.excerpt: The new Horde Siege mode in Gears of War: E-Day is winning over previewers, who can't stop playing the co-op survival mode.
deals.translation_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》新 Horde 围攻模式上手体验：令人欲罢不能的联机生存玩法。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《战争机器：E-Day》全新 Horde 围攻模式在试玩中获得一致好评，合作生存玩法令人上瘾。

deals.title: Mistfall Hunter Now on Xbox Game Pass — Reviews Roundup
deals.excerpt: Action RPG Mistfall Hunter launches on Xbox Game Pass today. Early reviews are positive, highlighting the combat system and world design. Here's the full roundup.
deals.translation_zh: Mistfall Hunter 登陆 Xbox Game Pass，媒体评价汇总
deals.excerpt_zh: 动作 RPG Mistfall Hunter 今日加入 Xbox Game Pass。首批评测出炉，战斗系统和世界设计获高度评价。

deals.title: Dispatch Launches on Xbox with Play Anywhere Support
deals.excerpt: Critically acclaimed narrative game Dispatch is now available on Xbox with Play Anywhere support, meaning one purchase covers both Xbox console and PC. Grab it on the Xbox Store today.
deals.translation_zh: 《Dispatch》登陆 Xbox 支持 Play Anywhere
deals.excerpt_zh: 备受好评的叙事游戏《Dispatch》现已登陆 Xbox 并支持 Play Anywhere，一次购买即可在 Xbox 主机和 PC 上游玩。现在就到 Xbox 商店入手。

deals.title: Xbox FanFest Gamescom 2026 Sign-Ups Closing Soon
deals.excerpt: Xbox FanFest registration for Gamescom 2026 is closing imminently. Sign up now for a chance to win tickets to the Cologne event with a friend — free to enter for Xbox fans.
deals.translation_zh: Xbox FanFest 科隆游戏展2026报名即将截止
deals.excerpt_zh: Xbox FanFert 科隆游戏展2026活动报名即将截止。立即注册即有机会赢取双人门票前往科隆现场——Xbox 玩家免费参与。

deals.title: Monopoly Go x The Simpsons Crossover Event Launching Soon
deals.excerpt: Monopoly Go teams up with The Simpsons for a new crossover event, bringing Springfield-themed content to the popular mobile game.
deals.translation_zh: 《大富翁GO》联动《辛普森一家》即将开启，春田镇主题内容来袭。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《大富翁GO》与《辛普森一家》联动活动即将上线，为这款热门手游带来春田镇主题内容。

deals.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.3 Adds New Story Chapter and Character
deals.excerpt: Version 4.3 of Honkai: Star Rail brings a new story chapter and makes Mortenax Blade playable, launching June 1 for all players.
deals.translation_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.3 版本新增剧情章节，Mortenax Blade 角色登场，6月1日上线。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.3 版本带来全新剧情章节，Mortenax Blade 成为可玩角色，6月1日全平台上线。

deals.title: Forza Horizon 6 Surges on Steam Ahead of Official Launch
deals.excerpt: Forza Horizon 6 is already climbing Steam charts via premium early access before its official release date. Racers can buy the premium edition now to start driving immediately.
deals.translation_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》正式发售前已登顶 Steam 热榜
deals.excerpt_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》通过高级抢先体验在正式发售前已冲上 Steam 畅销榜。竞速玩家可购买高级版立即开始驰骋。

deals.title: Forza Horizon 6 Review: Still the Best Driving Game — With One Catch
deals.excerpt: Forza Horizon 6 keeps its crown as the most accessible racing game around, though the car-collecting progression system remains divisive.
deals.translation_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》评测：依然是最易上手的赛车游戏——但有一个槽点。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《极限竞速：地平线6》继续保持最亲民赛车游戏的称号，但车辆收集养成系统仍存在争议。

deals.title: Genshin Impact's Luna 7 Update Introduces First Playable Hexenzirkel
deals.excerpt: Genshin Impact's upcoming Luna 7 update brings major Sumeru story developments and the first playable Hexenzirkel member.
deals.translation_zh: 《原神》Luna 7 版本更新：首位可玩的魔女会成员登场，须弥剧情迎来转折。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《原神》即将到来的 Luna 7 版本带来须弥重大剧情发展，并推出首位可玩的魔女会成员。

deals.title: Petit Planet: HoYoverse's First Family-Friendly Game Impressions
deals.excerpt: A hands-on look at Petit Planet, HoYoverse's first attempt at a family-friendly title — careful, charming, and colouring within the lines.
deals.translation_zh: 《Petit Planet》前瞻：米哈游首款家庭友好向游戏初体验，精致而稳妥。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《Petit Planet》试玩前瞻：米哈游首款家庭友好向游戏，精致可爱且谨慎稳妥。

deals.title: Zenless Zone Zero Version 2.8 Adds New Mechanic, Steam Launch Confirmed
deals.excerpt: HoYoverse's action RPG Zenless Zone Zero gets a Version 2.8 update refreshing team compositions, and the game is officially coming to Steam. Wishlist now to play on PC's biggest platform.
deals.translation_zh: 《绝区零》2.8版本更新并确认登陆 Steam
deals.excerpt_zh: HoYoverse 动作 RPG《绝区零》2.8版本更新阵容搭配机制，同时确认将登陆 Steam。现在即可加入愿望单，在 PC 最大平台上体验。

deals.title: Diablo 4's Next Season Skips New Mechanics to Focus on Expansion
deals.excerpt: Blizzard confirms Diablo 4's next season won't add new mechanics, with all development focus on the Lord of Hatred expansion.
deals.translation_zh: 《暗黑破坏神4》下赛季不加新机制，全力开发《仇恨之王》资料片。
deals.excerpt_zh: 暴雪确认《暗黑破坏神4》下一赛季将不加入新机制，全部开发资源集中于《仇恨之王》资料片。

deals.title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred Review — A Compelling, Cinematic Conclusion
deals.excerpt: The Lord of Hatred expansion delivers a compelling conclusion to Diablo 4's story with the cinematic panache that proves Blizzard still has it.
deals.translation_zh: 《暗黑破坏神4：仇恨之王》评测：引人入胜的史诗终章，证明暴雪宝刀未老。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《仇恨之王》资料片为《暗黑破坏神4》的故事线带来精彩收尾，电影级表现证明暴雪实力犹存。

deals.title: The Sims 4 Paid Mods Roll Out to Consoles, Kits Return to PC
deals.excerpt: The Sims 4's controversial paid mods system has finally arrived on consoles, while Kits are making a return to PC.
deals.translation_zh: 《模拟人生4》付费 Mod 系统登陆主机，PC 版 Kits 套件回归。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《模拟人生4》备受争议的付费模组系统终于登陆主机平台，PC 版 Kits 套件同步回归。

deals.title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred Expansion — Full Reveal Coming Soon
deals.excerpt: Blizzard is set to share final details about the Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred expansion before launch. Here's what we know so far about the biggest D4 content drop yet.
deals.translation_zh: 暗黑破坏神4：仇恨之主资料片即将全面揭晓
deals.excerpt_zh: 暴雪即将在发售前公布暗黑破坏神4「仇恨之主」资料片的最终详情。以下是这部 D4 史上最大内容更新的已知情报。

deals.title: Metro 2039 Returns to Underground Roots With a Powerful New Story
deals.excerpt: Metro 2039 goes back to the series' underground survival roots, with a narrative shaped by the war in Ukraine and its human cost.
deals.translation_zh: 《地铁2039》回归地下生存本源，以乌克兰战争为背景的震撼叙事。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《地铁2039》回归系列地下生存的本源，其叙事深受乌克兰战争及其人道影响所塑造。

deals.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons Adds Free 25th Anniversary Item
deals.excerpt: Nintendo celebrates Animal Crossing's 25th anniversary with a new free in-game item for New Horizons players.
deals.translation_zh: 《集合啦！动物森友会》推出25周年纪念免费道具。
deals.excerpt_zh: 任天堂为庆祝《动物森友会》系列25周年，向《集合啦！动物森友会》玩家发放全新免费纪念道具。

deals.title: Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.2 Kicks Off Third Anniversary Celebrations
deals.excerpt: Honkai: Star Rail players are in for a treat as Version 4.2 launches alongside the game's third anniversary celebrations later this month.
deals.translation_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.2 版本与三周年庆典同步开启，玩家福利满满。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》4.2 版本将于本月与游戏三周年庆典同步上线，玩家福利丰厚。

deals.title: Heartopia Marks 30M Downloads with New Outfits and Price Cuts
deals.excerpt: Life sim Heartopia celebrates 30 million downloads with a content update that includes new outfits and permanent price cuts on premium items. More accessible than ever.
deals.translation_zh: Heartopia 庆祝3000万下载，新装扮+永久降价
deals.excerpt_zh: 生活模拟游戏 Heartopia 庆祝 3000 万下载里程碑，推出包含新装扮的内容更新，多款付费道具永久降价，门槛更低了。

deals.title: The Petit Planet Beta Returns with New Updates
deals.excerpt: The Petit Planet beta is coming back with fresh content updates. HoYoverse's family-friendly adventure gets new areas and features. Registration still open if you haven't signed up.
deals.translation_zh: Petit Planet 二测回归，全新内容更新
deals.excerpt_zh: 米哈游旗下休闲冒险游戏 Petit Planet 二次测试即将开启，新增地图和功能。尚未注册的玩家仍可报名参与。

deals.title: Love and Deepspace: Caleb's Third Myth Arrives for Fans
deals.excerpt: Love and Deepspace adds Caleb's long-awaited third Myth storyline, delivering good news for fans of the popular romance character.
deals.translation_zh: 《恋与深空》凯列第三条神话线终于上线，角色粉迎来好消息。
deals.excerpt_zh: 《恋与深空》推出人气角色凯列的第三条神话剧情线，为角色粉丝带来好消息。

deals.title: PS5 Summer Sale Live: Spider-Man 2 & Astro Bot Discounted
deals.excerpt: Sony's PS5 Summer Sale is now live, with discounts on physical and digital copies of Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Astro Bot, and other popular titles. Check the PSN store and local retailers for the best bundle prices.
deals.excerpt_zh: 索尼 PS5 夏季促销现已开启，《漫威蜘蛛侠 2》《宇宙机器人》等热门作品的实体版和数字版均有折扣。查看 PSN 商店和本地零售商获取最佳捆绑价格。

deals.title: Tetris 99 Drops Free Splatoon Raiders Crossover Theme This Week
deals.excerpt: A new limited-time crossover event is live in Tetris 99 to mark the launch of Splatoon Raiders on Switch 2. Players can earn an exclusive Splatoon-themed skin by climbing the event leaderboard — free for all Nintendo Switch Online members.
deals.translation_zh: 《俄罗斯方块99》本周推出免费《斯普拉遁 突袭者》联动主题
deals.excerpt_zh: 为庆祝《斯普拉遁 突袭者》在 Switch 2 上发售，《俄罗斯方块99》推出限时联动活动。所有 Nintendo Switch Online 会员均可免费参与，冲榜即可解锁专属斯普拉遁主题皮肤。

deals.title: Nintendo Sets Dedicated Direct for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
deals.excerpt: Nintendo has scheduled a focused Direct presentation entirely around Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave for Switch 2, airing 4 August 2026 at 3pm BST. Expect an extended gameplay deep-dive ahead of the strategy RPG's launch.
deals.translation_zh: 任天堂宣布举办《火焰之纹章 命运之织》专属直面会
deals.excerpt_zh: 任天堂宣布将于 2026 年 8 月 4 日英国夏令时下午 3 点举办一场完全聚焦《火焰之纹章 命运之织》的直面会，预计将带来这款 Switch 2 策略 RPG 发售前的深入玩法展示。

deals.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 PS5 Port Gets Emergency Security Patch
deals.excerpt: Activision has rushed out an emergency update for the PS5 port of Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 after legacy hack attacks left some players' accounts bricked. If you own the port, install the patch before hopping back into multiplayer.
deals.translation_zh: 《使命召唤：黑色行动2》PS5 版紧急发布安全补丁
deals.excerpt_zh: 由于旧版黑客攻击导致部分玩家 PS5 账号被锁死，动视紧急推送了《使命召唤：黑色行动2》PS5 版的安全补丁。已购入该版本的玩家请务必先更新再返回多人对战。

deals.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag: Resynced Gets 5GB PS5 Improvement Patch
deals.excerpt: A roughly 5GB patch lands for Assassin's Creed Black Flag: Resynced on PS5 from 4 August, bringing further visual and performance refinements to the refreshed pirate adventure. Existing owners get the update free.
deals.translation_zh: 《刺客信条：黑旗 重制版》PS5 推出约 5GB 优化补丁
deals.excerpt_zh: 《刺客信条：黑旗 重制版》PS5 版将于 8 月 4 日起推送约 5GB 的补丁，为这款焕新海盗冒险带来进一步的画质与性能优化。已购玩家可免费更新。

deals.title: Attack on Titan 3 Confirmed for December on PS5, Sidesteps GTA 6
deals.excerpt: Attack on Titan 3 has locked in a December 2026 release on PS5, deliberately steering clear of the crowded September launch window and GTA 6. Good news for fans who want both titans without choosing.
deals.translation_zh: 《进击的巨人3》确认 12 月登陆 PS5，避开 GTA 6 档期
deals.excerpt_zh: 《进击的巨人3》已锁定 2026 年 12 月在 PS5 发售，刻意避开了 9 月拥挤的发售窗口及 GTA 6。对于想同时入手两部大作的玩家来说是个好消息。

deals.title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Game Builds Early Competitive Buzz on PS5
deals.excerpt: Sony's upcoming Marvel fighting game is reportedly off to a strong start on the competitive circuit ahead of launch, with pro players praising its mechanics. A healthy esports scene could extend its lifespan well beyond release.
deals.translation_zh: 漫威格斗游戏《Marvel Tokon》PS5 发售前已获电竞圈好评
deals.excerpt_zh: 索尼即将推出的漫威格斗游戏在发售前已在竞技圈获得强劲反响，职业选手对其机制给予好评。健康的电竞生态有望大幅延长这款 PS5 作品的生命周期。

deals.title: Mortal Shell 2 Open Beta Now Live and Free on Xbox Series X|S
deals.excerpt: The Mortal Shell 2 open beta is available now for free on Xbox Series X|S, and early player feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. Worth a download if you enjoy soulslikes — no purchase required to try the prologue.
deals.translation_zh: 《致命躯壳2》公开测试现已在 Xbox Series X|S 免费开玩
deals.excerpt_zh: 《致命躯壳2》公开测试现已在 Xbox Series X|S 免费开放，玩家初期反馈极为正面。喜欢魂系游戏的玩家值得一试——体验序章无需任何购买。

deals.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 (PS5 Physical) Drops to $10 at Amazon
deals.excerpt: Amazon has the physical PS5 edition of PGA TOUR 2K25 on sale for just $10, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35. One of the cheapest entry points yet for the golf sim.
deals.translation_zh: 《PGA巡回赛2K25》PS5 实体版亚马逊降至 10 美元
deals.excerpt_zh: 亚马逊将《PGA巡回赛2K25》PS5 实体版降至仅 10 美元，Prime 会员或满 35 美元订单可享免邮。这是这款高尔夫模拟游戏目前最便宜的入手价之一。

deals.title: Razer Wolverine V3 Tournament Controller Down to $50 (Was ~$100)
deals.excerpt: The Razer Wolverine V3 Tournament Edition wired gaming controller is currently $49.99 at Amazon with free shipping — roughly half its usual price. A solid pickup for competitive Xbox/PC players wanting extra bumpers.
deals.translation_zh: 雷蛇 Wolverine V3 竞技版有线手柄降至 50 美元（原价约 100 美元）
deals.excerpt_zh: 雷蛇 Wolverine V3 竞技版有线游戏手柄目前在亚马逊售价 49.99 美元且免邮，约为原价的一半。对于想要额外肩键的 Xbox/PC 竞技玩家来说是不错的入手时机。
